LatLng.description: An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this object must conform to the WGS84 standard. Values must be within normalized ranges.

latitude.description: The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].

longitude.description: The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].

ListNearestRoadsResponse.description: The response from the ListNearestRoads method, returning a list of snapped points.

ListSpeedLimitsResponse.description: The response from the ListSpeedLimits method, returning a list of speed limits.

snappedPoints.description: A list of snapped points (if a path was snapped as part of the process).

speedLimits.description: A list of speed limits for each point.

warningMessage.description: User-visible warning message, if any, which can be shown alongside a valid result.

ListTrafficSpeedsForTileResponse.description: The response from the ListTrafficSpeedsForTile method, returning a list of traffic speeds for segments contained in the requested tile. The results are returned as a set of repeated fields, where the indices into each field line up. Only one of place_id and openlr can contain values. Only one of current_speed and freeflow_speed can contain values.

freeflowSpeeds.description: The speed without traffic of each road segment.
